I make a big batch of chicken curry in the slow cooker every few weeks to stick in the freezer for lunches. It's really easy and i make my own curry paste too. Chuck black mustard seeds, garlic, ginger, chillis, shallots (the little onion looking ones not the green ones), garam masala, cumin, tumeric and salt and pepper in a mortar and pestle (or use a bowl and the end of a rolling pin) and turn it all into a paste that doesn't have to be too smooth. Add that to the slow cooker to cook the spices a bit then throw in cleaned and chunked chicken thighs, a couple of cans of crushed tomatoes and a can of coconut cream. I also chuck in a few cans of chick peas. Let it cook for a couple of hours and it's fuckin tasty.

You can find quantities for the paste easily in many different recipes. I found about half a dozen that were all similar and made up my own variation.
